propositions: 836 truncated bridge-echo comments across three Jira issues carry no reconciler marker because outbound truncation removes the marker after cutting the body to 32767 characters

Truncated comments are reliably identified by the presence of the reconciler's own truncation suffix and absence of the reconciler marker, and must be deduplicated by keeping the oldest copy of each distinct normalized body when comment_ids map is empty
Phase 2 executed 827 successful deletions across REB-2605 (138), REB-1931 (276), and REB-1567 (414) with zero data loss, reducing duplicates from 145/298/430 to 7/22/16 respectively

The first bridge pass after re-enabling will re-post approximately one copy per distinct truncated comment because comment ids are recorded only on successful new posts and not backfilled for existing comments

The keep-one rule must invert for the post-re-enable final sweep to keep the bridge-recorded copy (newest) rather than oldest, else the recorded comment_ids will reference deleted comments and re-create the original defect
